This website contains all analyses for our study of right ventricular remodelling in end-stage dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM).

The study includes single-nucleus RNA sequencing of snap-frozen right ventricular tissue from **21 patients with DCM** who underwent heart transplantation, together with proteomic profiling of right ventricular tissue from **44 patients with DCM** using mass spectrometry and Olink Reveal.
